[[Rien's Sacrifice]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Rien, the Martyr]], a [[boss]] in the [[Shenzun Tunnels]], and [[Am Fah Leader]] in [[The Undercity]] (only during the quest [[Capturing the Orrian Tome]]).

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:[[Healing Prayers]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item has the same [[skin]] as the [[Healing Ankh]].

==Replica==
Exact replicas of this item are [[Healing Ankh]]s from collectors [[Losi Hapatu]] or [[Jahn Pitz]] or crafter [[Sheco]].


It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Healing Ankh]] from collector [[Ivarr Stewbrewer]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*[[Healing Ankh]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Healing Prayers]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from [[collector]] [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Healing Prayers]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
